promo.a: For the first 3 months after launch, all plans, VIP and reports are free. At the end of the period you won't be charged automatically — we'll send you a notification.

cancel.a: Yes, at any time. Your subscription stays active until the end of the current period.

vip.a: In My listings, select a listing, click Enable VIP and choose 7 or 30 days.

reports.q: What's included in a location report?
reports.a: Average price per m² in the district, active and vacant spaces, competitors, and in the Pro version — foot traffic and location score. Reports come as PDF.

payment.a: By card, on the Bank of Georgia or TBC payment page. We don't store your card details.

invoice.a: Yes, invoices and receipts for all payments are available as PDF on the Payments page in your account.

commission.q: When do I pay a commission?
commission.a: In the services marketplace, the provider pays a commission on each completed order. For business transfers — after the deal closes.

api.q: Who can use the analytics API?
api.a: Organizations and individuals. Keys are created on the developer page; limits depend on your plan.
